products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Fingerprint/face unlock (works on Class-2 sensors too), built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. NEW in v1.3.0: the two biggest real-world bugs are fixed for good — 'gallery won't open' (phones whose gallery picker silently fails now get an instant one-tap file-browser fallback) and 'PIN won't save' (vault creation writes are now synchronous, so an aggressive memory killer can never eat a fresh setup; setup failures show a clear in-app message instead of crashing; the lock screen always has a manual Unlock button as a safety net). Plus app disguise (Calculator / Notes / Gallery / custom icon) and recovery question.

notes: FIXED 'gallery won't open': phones whose gallery picker silently fails now get a one-tap file-browser fallback
FIXED 'PIN won't save': synchronous vault writes — an aggressive memory killer can never eat a fresh setup
Setup failures show a clear in-wizard message; the lock screen always keeps a manual Unlock button
Photo import + custom shortcut icons fixed on every phone
Step-by-step professional PIN setup wizard
Fingerprint login works on Class-2 (budget) sensors
App disguise — Calculator / Notes / Gallery launcher looks
AES-256-GCM PIN vault, biometric unlock, encrypted viewer, export

products.tagline: 31 hand-crafted widgets — now with the NewThing-style DOT MATRIX set
products.description: 38 home-screen widgets in the Ophelia red-on-black look — clocks, weather, battery, notes, tools, gauges, fun — plus TWO full Nothing-style DOT MATRIX batches (15 dot widgets). NEW in v1.5.0: the Sunrise/Sunset widget runs in the CITY’s own timezone — Tokyo times are Tokyo wall-clock with a live NOW line and a UTC offset chip, and the day flips at the city’s local midnight. v1.4.0 added Game Score scoreboard, Days Since, Week Number, Uptime, Hydro hydration tracker (with optional reminders), live Currency Rate (USD→INR with change arrows) and Sunrise/Sunset (offline NOAA math). v1.3.0 added App Shortcut, App Folder, Month Calendar, Steps, Now Playing, Web Search, AI Bar and Contact Dial — all in the dot look. Everything is offline-first: no accounts, no analytics; only weather/rates fetch (keyless) when you place those widgets.

products.name: Junk Cleaner
products.tagline: Smart clean · duplicates · SIMILAR PHOTOS + VIDEOS (no root)
products.description: Storage rescue without root: junk scan (thumbnail caches, empty folders, leftover installers, temp files), the 25 biggest files, byte-identical duplicate finder (full-hash verified), SIMILAR PHOTOS — a perceptual hash groups photos that LOOK the same (burst shots, WhatsApp re-sends) even when bytes differ — and now SIMILAR VIDEOS: four keyframes are sampled across each clip's timeline and fingerprinted, so a re-sent or re-encoded copy of the SAME video groups with its original (the 200 MB heavy hitters, not just photos). Each group keeps the LARGEST copy (the least-compressed one); deletion goes through the app's confirmation AND Android's own delete sheet. Plus a system-wide cache boost and a per-app cache dashboard. Nothing is ever removed silently — every byte is reviewed first.

notes: SIMILAR VIDEOS — the heavy hitters: re-sent and re-encoded copies of the SAME clip now group up (one 200 MB re-send chain frees more than every photo group combined)
4 keyframes sampled across each video's timeline, fingerprinted with the photo pipeline; flat frames are dropped so two 'opens on black' clips can't false-group
Duration gate (±1.5 s or ±8%) + both-directions 3-of-4 frame agreement — trimmed re-cuts are deliberately NOT grouped
keeper = the largest file · live progress while fingerprinting · Android's own delete sheet on 30+ · 20 new tests (55 total green)
SIMILAR PHOTOS: perceptual-hash review — burst shots, HDR takes and WhatsApp re-sends grouped even when bytes differ
Each group keeps the LARGEST copy (least compressed); a '% alike' chip shows how close they are
Deletion is double-confirmed: the app's dialog, then Android's own system delete sheet (API 30+)
Live progress while fingerprinting the library ('Fingerprinting 320/1,245 photos…') + unreadable-image skip count
The app now asks for real Android permissions (Photos & videos, Music & audio) with a one-tap card — the app-info Permissions page lists them properly instead of showing 'no permissions requested'.
New launcher icon: your own Junk Cleaner artwork, full-bleed adaptive icon.
All v1.1.0 features unchanged: Big Files top-25, hash-verified duplicate finder, cache boost, per-app cache dashboard.
NEW BIG FILES: the 25 largest files on storage, per-file confirm delete
NEW DUPLICATES: byte-identical copies (size + full-hash verified), keep-first one-tap clean with review

products.name: EasyPair
products.tagline: Offline high-speed sharing — no data, no limits, and interrupted transfers RESUME
products.description: Offline file sharing with zero limits — Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, same Wi-Fi, USB cable or Bluetooth, no router and no data needed. Photos, videos, audio, files, folders, installed apps (APK) and clipboard text. v1.6.0 adds PARTIAL-FILE RESUME: big transfers (8 MB+) are received into a private .part buffer, so when the link drops mid-video the finished bytes STAY — tap RESUME and only the missing tail is re-sent (first-4KB SHA-256 proves it's the same file; works over every channel including Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct; partials self-clean after 14 days). v1.5.0 added the encrypted receiver (Android-Keystore TLS + pinned cert), v1.4.0 pinned encrypted LocalSend senders, v1.3.0 brought full LocalSend v2 interop, an in-app gallery and real runtime media permissions.

notes: NEW: PARTIAL-FILE RESUME — interrupted transfers continue from the exact byte, never from zero
Big files (8 MB+) are received into a private .part buffer; a drop at 80% of a video keeps those bytes safe
RESUME TRANSFER card on Home + Queue after a failed batch — one tap and only the missing tail travels
Same-file proof: first-4KB SHA-256 must match, so a different file with the same name can never corrupt a partial; stale partials (14 days) self-clean
NEW: ENCRYPTED RECEIVER — flip 'Encrypted receiver (HTTPS)' in Settings and EasyPair itself serves LocalSend behind TLS
Certificate is generated in the Android Keystore (hardware-backed where available); the private key never leaves your phone
Our announcement now carries the certificate's real SHA-256 — LocalSend and EasyPair senders PIN us, nothing travels in the clear
Default OFF (LocalSend's own default): plain-HTTP interop keeps working exactly as before until you opt in
NEW: ENCRYPTED LOCALSEND — LocalSend receivers that enable HTTPS mode are now supported
REAL certificate pinning: the announced SHA-256 fingerprint must match the presented certificate or the handshake is refused — never trust-all
Encrypted peers show a lock + 'encrypted' badge in the nearby device list
8 new tests including a real self-signed HTTPS server round-trip (pinned pass / wrong-pin reject / unpinned reject)
NEW: LocalSend interop — receive from the LocalSend app on Windows/macOS/Linux/iOS/Android (multicast discovery 224.0.0.167, HTTP REST v2.2 on port 53317)
NEW: send TO any LocalSend receiver over HTTP REST (prepare-upload + upload, both wire generations supported)
NEW: incoming LocalSend files verified with SHA-256 when the sender provides a hash, saved to Downloads/LocalSend and listed in Received Files
27 new JVM protocol tests; gesture/UI untouched — same look, same flow
